This tutorial introduces to custom models with the package `housepi`. 

We'll walk through the process of associating augmented variable to individuals to then proceed with standard model generation and inference. 

To create a custom model without starting from scratch, we copy a template model to a custom path with the function `template_model`:

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# copy the heterogeneous chain binomial template to a custom directory

my_model_path <- "custom_project"
housepi::template_model(which = "chain_binom_heter", path = my_model_path)
```

Modify all relevant parts of the C++ implementation *model.cpp* and of the header *model.h* within your model directory. *Note:* to avoid errors we recommend changing only the chunks of code indicated with "CHANGE-ME".

We generate according to the custom directory. All other commands remain the same.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
hemi <- housepi::generate_model(my_model_path)
```



```{r, eval=FALSE}
housepi::build_model(hemi, data="survey.csv", params =  params$df)
```
